messages:
Raj Patel - AeroNova: hey team — we'd like to onboard a custom maintenance-log summarizer (13B) for our drone fleet. private deployment required (on-prem or VPC), must integrate with our HSM for model keys. timeline: pilot in ~6 weeks. can you confirm feasibility and any blockers?

Maria (CS): @Raj thanks for the ping. quick clarifying q's: is there PHI/PCI? what's the expected qps and latency SLO? are you bringing your own weights or expecting Redwood to host a vetted variant? :calendar:

Raj Patel - AeroNova: no PHI/PCI, but logs contain proprietary serials and flight incident text — must be treated as IP. expecting ~20 reqs/s peak for pilot, p50 latency target ~120ms for short prompts (~64 tokens). we will provide the model artifact (private weights) and a 20k-line sample of logs.

Sam (Solutions): got it. primary options: Redwood Private (VPC) with HSM integration or on-prem package. For latency, recommend a quantized 13B (4-bit/LLM.int8 or q4_0) + pinned Dedicated GPUs if Private not fully on-prem. Can do a canary + rollout.

Jin (EngOps): @sam @maria adding infra notes — HSM integration requires customer KMS/HSM endpoint and our connector deployed into their network. network egress must be locked down. for on-prem we need a 2 week provisioning window once contracts are done. also need a shortbench: `runtimes/bench --model ./artifact --seq 64 --batch 1` to validate the 120ms p50 on target hardware.

Maria (CS): @Lisa any legal/regs watchouts? customer mentioned IP and serial numbers — export control?

Lisa (Legal): check: model contains only operational logs (no biometrics), but IP restrictions and an NDA addendum are required. also need an MSA addendum for key custody and incident notif windows. export control looks clear but we'll need a vendor attestation from AeroNova about dataset sources.

Raj Patel - AeroNova: we can sign NDA addendum. sample logs link: s3://aeronova-pilot/samples/maint-logs-20k.txt (read-only token ready).

Sam (Solutions): next steps I propose:
1) CS intake + legal NDA addendum signed
2) infra & HSM design call (Jin + AeroNova infra)
3) eval harness run (robustness + prompt-injection tests)
4) canary deploy to Private with fallback to hosted 13B if perf/compat fails

Jin (EngOps): for the eval harness, we'll run these commands on our side once we have the artifact and sample prompts:
```
run-eval --suite maintenance-robustness --model-path /mnt/artifacts/aeronova-13b --max-seq 128
python tools/prompt-injection-check.py --input samples/maint-logs-20k.txt
```
Expect ~48-72h to complete the first pass.

Maria (CS): FYI AeroNova is mid-contract renewal with legal pending the pilot success — if we delay the pilot >4 weeks there's a material renewal risk. scheduling the enablement + kickoff this week helps reduce that risk.

Raj Patel - AeroNova: understood, we need pilot start within 6 weeks. can you share an ETA for onboarding steps (legal + infra + eval)?

Maria (CS): estimated schedule if we start now:
- NDA addendum and MSA review: 3-7 business days (Lisa)
- Infra design & HSM connector setup: 7-14 business days after contracts
- Artifact ingestion + eval run: 3 business days for ingestion, 2-3 days for eval pass
- Canary deploy & smoke tests: 2 business days
Total optimistic: ~3 weeks after contracts, conservative ~5-6 weeks. we'll push to hit the 6-week pilot goal.

Lisa (Legal): I'll open the NDA addendum PR by EOD and route to AeroNova. tagging @Raj when I send.

DeployBot: created ticket INFRA-4721: "AeroNova HSM connector & private onboarding" — assignees: Jin. Estimated work: 5 dev-days. CI pipeline skeleton created.

Jin (EngOps): I'll pick up INFRA-4721, will need access to customer's KMS test endpoint and the artifact tarball. Raj please DM creds or use secure transfer.

Raj Patel - AeroNova: will DM creds + a read-only token to the S3 sample. also attaching a short prompt set in the S3 folder for eval.

Sam (Solutions): I'll draft the rollout plan and canary criteria (quality threshold + latency thresholds). planning doc will include prompts for regression alerts.

Maria (CS): scheduling kickoff: Fri 11am PT — invite sent. agenda: legal signoff status, infra checklist, eval criteria, success metrics. Raj can you confirm? :thumbsup:

Raj Patel - AeroNova: confirmed for Fri 11am PT. thanks all.

Maria (CS): flagging risk in CRM: if kickoff slips >1 week we mark as 'renewal at risk' and escalate to AE. I'll update. :rotating_light:

Sam (Solutions): one more note — ask AeroNova to strip serials from the sample prompts or provide a redaction mapping so we can include some automated leakage checks. helps speed up legal review.

Raj Patel - AeroNova: we can provide mapping. thanks, team.
